summary.en: Ten years ago, Masumi, taken by her middle brother Shukichi and their mother Mary, reunite with Shuichi who did not take the test yet to become an FBI agent in the Atsuhama Beach, Shizuoka Prefecture. Mary had an off-screen fight with him where they both managed to injure each other's eye. Through out the case Mary warns him to stop investigating the disappearance of his father. The Akai family also encountered Shinichi, Ran and Yukiko who also happened to be there. Shinichi introduce himself as "Holmes Apprentice". All of them end up being involved in a case where two robbers robbed a watch shop with one of them accidentally got killed in an accident, and the other was still on the run. When the vehicle crashed into the guardrail, the driver's head smashed into the windshield, breaking his cervical vertebrae in the process. The man was killed upon impact.
